summary: Diana Shipping Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 7, 2026, announcing a time charter contract for its Capesize vessel m/v Florida with Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha (NYK). The charter is at a gross rate of US$30,500 per day, minus a 5% commission, for 32–35.5 months, expected to commence in Q2 2027. This is a routine operational contract, not a special situation. The filing includes forward-looking statements but no transaction, corporate action, or strategic event. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; routine fleet employment announcement.
